title: Race simulation 4h: 33km, ~1,200m D+
terrain: Berici hills if possible, start 10:00 like race day
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 10:00 start after race breakfast at 07:00. Race kit, race shoes. Hike over 15%.
GYM: none.
FUEL: Race plan: Tailwind 1 flask/h + gel every 40min, ~70g carb/h. Log what you actually ate.
STOP RULE: calf or knee signal = stop at 3h.
WHY: Last kit and fuelling change is allowed today, not after.
